parties: Ashdan Township Holdings Private Limited (acquirer) / DS Kulkarni Developers Limited (target)
headline: DS Kulkarni Developers: Acquisition by Ashdan Township Holdings completed
sum: Ashdan Township Holdings Private Limited has completed the acquisition of equity shares in DS Kulkarni Developers Limited, with transfer formalities now concluded and intimated to the NSE.
implication: Completion notice filed with exchange signals final closure of transaction; counsel should verify whether escrow, earn-out or post-closing conditions remain open and confirm filing of regulatory approvals (NCLT if applicable, FIPB/sectoral clearances).
detail: DS Kulkarni Developers Limited, a Mumbai-based real estate developer, has been acquired by Ashdan Township Holdings Private Limited. The company's intimation to the National Stock Exchange on 22 August 2026 formally notified the completion of equity share transfer formalities, marking the conclusion of the acquisition transaction. The exact consideration, purchase price structure, and any conditions precedent are not disclosed in the exchange filing.
